events.quote: Present petition has been filed challenging the order dated 25.04.2024 passed under Section 73 of the U.P. Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
as well as the order dated 17.01.2025 whereby the appeal was dismissed as being beyond limitation.

defects_argued.quote: Since the aforesaid dictum is applicable in the present facts and circumstances, accordingly, the impugned orders cannot be sustained and the orders dated 25.04.2024 & 17.01.2025 are accordingly quashed.

outcome.quote: With the aforesaid, the present petition is allowed.
